Why this card?

    Matches compare these eight themes. They are suggestions, not a species identification or a guarantee that something is present.

    Text only, saved in this browser. Photos are never saved.

    Your little collection

    SMALL SCREEN. BIG WORLD.

    The AI is here
    to send you away.

    Look Again uses an open-weight image–text model to match a photograph to a few visual themes. It chooses an invitation from our card library; it does not invent a description of your photo.

    The photo is processed in your browser. There is no photo upload, account, location request, analytics, or remote inference service. You can correct the model simply by choosing a different focus.

    Model, downloads & offline use

    SigLIP by Google, converted to ONNX by Xenova, runs through Transformers.js 3.8.1 and ONNX Runtime in a browser worker. The upstream model is licensed Apache-2.0.

    First use needs an internet connection to download the public model files (about 211 MB), JavaScript and runtime. Cached files can be reused, subject to your browser’s storage limits. After loading, inference is computed on this device. Offline reloading is not supported.
